title: NFL confirms it had pregame communications with Eagles regarding Jalen Hurts's blood clot

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL confirms it had pregame communications with Eagles regarding Jalen Hurts's blood clot
sources.description: The outside world (including anyone considering placing wagers on the game and/or the specific player's performance) had no idea that Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts had developed a blood clot in his leg before the team's Week 5 game in London against the Jaguars.
